paths.description: Homepage/current-results template and primary read-results journey; tested desktop/mobile plus preference, performance, network, security, discoverability, accessibility, and memory conditions.
Kalyan historical panel-chart template, representing the many de-duplicated panel/matka chart URLs in the sitemap.
Weekly number-reference/content template, representing secondary static content and its blinking presentation.
Contact form and personal-data entry flow, including labels, validation, loading/error implementation, and third-party scripts.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt to the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is pixel-identical in size and appearance to the default capture (139,152 bytes), and the CSS probe found no color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme, or light-dark() rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and define light/dark surface and text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Blinking and decorative animations do not respect reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS on the weekly template contains an infinite 1s blink-animation and the contact template contains an infinite spinner, but no prefers-reduced-motion rule was found by the CSS probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential animation in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and provide a static reduced-motion state.

findings.summary: The fixed colour palette does not explicitly adapt to increased contrast or forced colours.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules; the contrast-emulated capture did not reveal an authored alternative palette.
findings.suggestedFix: Use system colours and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adjustments for fixed buttons and dense result panels.

findings.summary: Cross-document navigation swaps abruptly rather than preserving context.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition usage across an MPA with 81 homepage links and many chart routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values, with reduced-motion respected.

findings.summary: Very long pages provide no scroll-state navigation or progress context.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout measured a 20,950px homepage and 30,091px chart page; DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a compact, accessible sticky section navigator or progress affordance that responds to scroll state.

findings.summary: Dense banners, repeated borders, fixed buttons, and long promotional copy overwhelm the live-result content.
findings.evidence: The first mobile/desktop viewport is dominated by a purple promotional block, a red banner, repeated borders, and two fixed controls before the result list; the homepage is 20,950px tall.
findings.suggestedFix: Lead with the current results, collapse secondary explanation, remove repeated decorative framing, and consolidate fixed actions.

findings.summary: Most interactive targets are too small for comfortable touch use.
findings.evidence: The evaluate probe measured 79 of 88 interactive elements below 24px in at least one dimension; many chart links are only 22px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 44x44 CSS-pixel hit areas or equivalent spacing and preserve visible :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: Reusable content blocks rely only on viewport media queries.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found many repeated card-like components but no @container or container-type rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable result/card regions containment and adapt typography/layout with container queries where they appear in different widths.

findings.summary: Live-result loading states do not explain progress or recovery.
findings.evidence: The first viewport showed “Loading...” with only a full-page Refresh action; result state is plain text with no status/live-region semantics or timeout guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose loading/result/error states with aria-live/status semantics and offer a scoped retry plus timeout/error explanation.

findings.summary: Heading order and landmarks do not provide a reliable document structure.
findings.evidence: axe reported heading-order, landmark-one-main, and region violations; the probe found no main, nav, header, footer, aside, or role landmarks.
findings.suggestedFix: Use header/nav/main/footer landmarks and repair the H1→H2→H3 hierarchy without choosing headings for visual size.

findings.summary: Chart text becomes extremely small on narrow screens.
findings.evidence: Chart CSS explicitly sets td to 9px below 500px and 3px below 320px; the mobile screenshot shows a dense 30,091px table.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep text at a readable minimum, restructure wide records into responsive rows/cards, and allow zoom/reflow instead of shrinking data to 3–9px.

findings.summary: The chart technically avoids overflow by shrinking thousands of cells below readable size.
findings.evidence: At 360px the layout reports no overflow, but authored media rules reduce table cells to 9px and then 3px, defeating usable reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a responsive data presentation with readable text and progressive disclosure rather than scaling the entire table down.

findings.summary: Templates contain extensive repetitive inline CSS and obsolete presentational markup.
findings.evidence: DOM artifacts show duplicated .link/.chart_btn/.faq blocks, inline style sections, align/font/big markup, and the chart contains 4,257 th plus 9,244 td nodes.
findings.suggestedFix: Extract shared components and styles, remove duplicate rules and obsolete presentational elements, and simplify the chart DOM.

findings.summary: The chart footer uses a javascript: history link instead of a normal navigable URL.
findings.evidence: The chart probe found BACK href="javascript:javascript:history.go(-1)", which is not crawlable or robust when opened directly.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real fallback href and progressively enhance it with history.back() only when history exists.

findings.summary: The contact page lacks a meta description.
findings.evidence: The contact DOM has a descriptive title but no meta[name=description].
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise, unique meta description describing the contact purpose.

findings.summary: The HTTPS site omits baseline security response headers.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a tested CSP and add HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The contact page loads Google Analytics before the user interacts with a personal-data form.
findings.evidence: Contact DOM/probe found Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager scripts, while the homepage tracker capture was otherwise third-party-free.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary analytics from the contact form or load privacy-preserving analytics only after an appropriate consent/legal basis, with data minimisation.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Header inspection found no HSTS, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Configure defensive response headers centrally and verify them on every template.

findings.summary: Dynamic results can remain in an indefinite loading state without an explicit network failure message.
findings.evidence: The captured homepage shows “Loading...” and a manual page Refresh, with no timeout, stale-data label, or targeted retry state in the DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Add timeout and failed/stale states with a targeted retry, preserve the last known result, and announce status changes.

findings.summary: Mixed English/Hindi content is not language-marked and layout CSS is physical-direction based.
findings.evidence: The root is lang="en-IN" while substantial Hindi content has no lang="hi" wrapper; CSS probe found no logical properties and 17 physical left/right declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark language changes, declare direction where needed, and replace physical offsets/margins with logical properties.

findings.summary: Displayed dates are hard-coded in one English format.
findings.evidence: Rendered templates include strings such as “21 July, 2026” and “Tuesday” with no locale selector or locale-aware semantic time markup visible in the DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Render dates from machine-readable values with Intl.DateTimeFormat and mark them with time[datetime].

findings.summary: The site’s disclaimers conflict with the content and calls to action.
findings.evidence: The page claims it does not support or associate with gambling while publishing “Satta Matka” results, “market tips,” number charts, and a persistent WhatsApp channel action.
findings.suggestedFix: State the product purpose, risks, provenance, and commercial relationship plainly; remove contradictory claims and any misleading “news/AI” framing.

findings.summary: The “exactly 10 digits” phone requirement is not encoded in validation.
findings.evidence: The phone input has type=tel and maxlength=10 but no pattern or inputmode; its script allows spaces and hyphens, so the stated exact-digit constraint can disagree with accepted input.
findings.suggestedFix: Use inputmode="numeric", an appropriate pattern/custom validation after interaction, and accessible inline error text tied with aria-describedby.

findings.summary: Contact fields omit autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The contact probe found no autocomplete attribute on name, phone, subject, or message controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete="name" and autocomplete="tel" where appropriate; use autocomplete="off" only for fields where reuse is genuinely harmful.

taskList.title: Make the result and chart templates readable, touch-friendly, and structurally accessible
Deploy baseline security headers and minimise analytics on the contact form
Replace contradictory gambling/news claims with transparent purpose, provenance, and risk language
Add resilient, accessible loading/error/retry states for live results
Respect dark, reduced-motion, and increased-contrast preferences
Modernise navigation and responsive component behaviour
Improve contact validation, autofill, and metadata
Internationalise mixed-language content and date formatting
Consolidate repetitive markup/CSS and replace javascript: navigation
